items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 76:1
items.html: (To the question) Like at the time of the Gadlut of Nekudim: after the aspect of the chest and below of ZA, which was in BYA, joined with him into a single Partzuf, then the Nukva also received from them the aspect of the lower nine, and was built into a Partzuf in itself, for the reason that, at the time of the smallness, when the Nukva was the aspect of the point of the chest of ZA, those of the chest and below that were in BYA belonged to the Nukva; therefore she was built from them into a Partzuf, after the Gadlut of ZA. And so it is in Atzilut: after ZA raises his NHY from BYA, there is in those NHY the part of the lower nine of the Nukva, and she too is built into a Partzuf separate from ZA — as in the Gadlut of Nekudim. (Part 1, Page 728, s.v. and behold).
